This template is to be used for citing individual entries from the [[Star Wars Droids App by Sphero|''Star Wars'' Droids App by Sphero]].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, paste it into the appropriate place in an article and fill in the required fields.

<code><nowiki>{{Sphero|text=|filename=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*'''text''': Name of the entry being cited.
*'''filename''': Filename of the entry's screenshot, minus the <code>File:</code> prefix.

===Examples===
<code><nowiki>{{Sphero|text=BB-2 and BB-4, BB Units|filename=BB-unit_Data_Sphero.jpg}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Sphero|text=BB-2 and BB-4, BB Units|filename=BB-unit_Data_Sphero.jpg}}
